how_to_run: Build a catalog of every installed skill's name + description (this kit's skills plus the externals/companions a workspace normally has), mix all eval queries into one numbered list, and have 3 independent judges route each query using ONLY the catalog — no repo access. Majority vote per query. Pass = trigger queries route here; no-trigger queries route anywhere else ('route' names the expected sibling, diagnostic only). In this repo, tools/trigger-evals/ holds the checked-in harness.

last_run.method: 3 independent fresh catalog-only judges over the full 540-query mixed set, deterministic shuffle; each judge had a private folder with its own copy of the judge prompt, catalog, and query list and was instructed to read nothing else, with no repository access (instruction-level isolation, not a sandbox; transcripts not inspected). Run after the /factory description changed for the hands-off run mode (one question, second-agent code review, merge and handover to manual QA). No query was added, changed, or removed. Single sweep.
last_run.result: 540/540 pass — majority vote passed every query; 537 unanimous, 3 passed 2/3.
last_run.judge_model: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), 3 independent Claude Code Agent-tool subagents
